description: On a pole at the Karlsrovägen roundabout at the entrance to the civil airfield at Flygstaden Halmstad. Rebuilt from three airframes 32094 32127 and 32035. First unveiled in 1994 inside the F 14 and FMTS area then restored in 2018 and 2019 and re-erected on this new site with a re-inauguration on 14 December 2019.
